reroute_reason: The prepared bundle attached the future business_date 2026-12-15 (and assumed currency EUR) to the t2s_baseline_schedule route as well as to dated_t2s_schedule, so both retrievals returned blocked (G02) and the bundle contained no evidence sections at all. topic-index.json lists t2s_baseline_schedule (T2S / settlement / current, roles csd_operator+participant, latest_review_date 2026-09-14) with required_context [], and business_date/currency are optional fields, so the nominal baseline is retrievable without a date. Corrected contexts (all taken from the index, one reroute): (1) t2s_baseline_schedule current with no business_date; (2) the original dated_t2s_schedule with business_date 2026-12-15 and currency EUR, kept unchanged so the G02 block stands and is disclosed; (3) release_status future, because 15 December 2026 falls after the R2026.NOV publication and the governing release is material; (4) november_operational_provisions, a listed blocked_question_type, to obtain the explicit G15 block rather than asserting the gap. Result: evidence_only / blocked / evidence_only / blocked, sections t2s-schedule-r2 and november-final-release.
notes: 10/10 deterministic checks passed on the first run; no fix pass needed. The answer refuses to state an actual schedule for a future date (G02), gives the R2026.JUN nominal baseline as a planning baseline only with the 'nominal is not guaranteed execution or a local participant cut-off' limitation attached, and adds the planned/revised/effective time model as the reason a future date cannot have an overlay. Release handling: R2026.NOV is stated as finally published (cover note 14 September 2026; UDFS document date 11 September 2026) with production deployment explicitly not verified, and the G15 block is disclosed; no deployment date is asserted because none is in this bundle (the Milan deployment-plan evidence named in the G15 reason was not retrieved here, so the 14/16 November dates mentioned in the system prompt were deliberately NOT used as evidence). Other qualifications kept: CET source convention with no UTC conversion, hash-identical re-fetch on 14 September 2026, platform release R2026.JUN, 'source identity checked; no independent whole-edition supervisory approval certification' on the schedule section and 'final document delivery confirmed; production deployment not verified' on the release section, plus the 'only cover-page statements are admitted' limitation. Also flagged that the T2S operating day calendar is absent, so whether 15 December 2026 is an EUR opening day, and its month position for the Table 37 penalty processes, is unresolved. Observation on tooling, not a case issue: reroute_case.py writes trace.json['original_contexts'] after overwriting trace['contexts'], so the trace's original_contexts now mirrors the new contexts rather than the pre-reroute ones; the pre-reroute contexts were t2s_baseline_schedule (with business_date 2026-12-15, currency EUR, _assumed currency=EUR) and dated_t2s_schedule (business_date 2026-12-15, currency EUR), both blocked with G02.
